projects.name: klew.dev
projects.tagline: Kubernetes incident investigation—with MCP for coding agents
projects.stack: Wails v2 · Go · React · Vite · client-go · MCP
highlights: Open-source (Apache 2.0) macOS desktop app that brings Kubernetes workloads, events, logs, and resource state into one workspace for on-call troubleshooting.
Connects to local or remote clusters through kubeconfig and the Kubernetes API (client-go); all data stays local with no SaaS backend.
MCP server so agents in Cursor, Claude, and other MCP clients can use klew’s investigation capabilities with cluster context on your machine.
Live cluster watches and periodic snapshots, with Drain3 grouping similar log and event lines so related failures show up together.
Investigation engine clusters repeated log patterns into a view of what failed and what else it affected.
